input.answer: I'm dropping my iShares Swap fund. Near the bottom the page says I'd be left with 59,196 ₪, with a red "פחות 19,980 ₪", while the one it marks "הזול" (Ilin Lapidot S&P 500 mimicking fund through a Psagot account) gets 86,492 ₪. So I'd lean towards that one, but I'm not sure. In the main list my fund just said "אין מחיר כאן" and the two places don't match.

stuck.where: Fund list, my own row (iShares S&P 500 Swap UCITS ETF USD (Acc), tagged הזנתם, 0.05%)
stuck.why: I added the fund to compare it, and the only answer I got was "אין מחיר כאן" and "עוד לא נאסף". No shekel number at all, so I kept scrolling to find one.

stuck.where: Bottom table "סוג קרן אחר, אותו חשבון"
stuck.why: Here my fund suddenly gets 59,196 ₪ and "פחות 19,980 ₪", with a lock icon. The list above said there was no price. And the other iShares fund bought abroad (Core) gets 81,171 ₪ "עוד". How can my fund with a 0.05% fee lose 20,000 ₪? I can't tell whether that's real or a mistake.

stuck.where: My fund's row shows the code IE00B5BMR087, and the very next row (iShares Core ... Accumulating) shows the same code
stuck.why: I couldn't tell if the page took my fund for the Core one or if they're the same thing.
The page started at 10,000 ₪ and 500 a month for 10 years, not my 30,000. I didn't touch it, so all the numbers are for an amount that isn't mine.
